findings.body: The completion requirement remains unmet. In packages/sdk/src/session-events.ts:109–114, typing events without orderedEnvelope still update typing state before an ordered baseline exists. Existing tests explicitly require this legacy behavior at apps/core/test/unit/control/sdk-transport.test.ts:660–663 and apps/core/test/unit/channels/app.test.ts:518. Also, apps/core/src/cli/memory.ts:280 still declares the snapshot optional, and lines 314–316 retain the no-snapshot display fallback. Remove these remaining compatibility paths and update their tests; neither omission requires another task.

Add the required end-to-end coverage to the repository test command, exercising persisted review rendering and ordered typing behavior through the real user entry points.
